
Load deconvolution
```{r}

```

Load spatial data
```{r}
load("Results/Spatial_features.RData")
```

Map IDs
```{r}
traitData = read.csv("../LungPredict2/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv")
traitData = traitData %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% rownames(deconv)) 
traitData <- traitData[match(rownames(deconv), traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk), ]
all.equal(rownames(deconv), traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk)

deconv = deconv %>%
  dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Samples = paste0("Patient_", traitData$AN)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Samples %in% rownames(data_spatial$Stroma)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Samples")
all.equal(rownames(deconv), rownames(data_spatial$Stroma))
```

Benchmarking deconvolution and spatial
```{r}
for(i in 1:length(data_spatial)){
  #Rename spatial features
  spatial_features <- data_spatial[[i]] %>%
    dplyr::rename("CD8.cells" = "CD8+",
                  "Cancer" = "Tumor_cells+",
                  "tDC1" = "cDC1+",
                  "tDC2" = "cDC2+",
                  "tpDC" = "pDC+",
                  "tDC3" = "Mature_DC+") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Dendritic.cells = rowSums(across(c(tpDC, tDC1, tDC2, tDC3))))
  
  x = deconv[,grep("tpDC", colnames(deconv))]
  y = spatial_features[,grep("tpDC", colnames(spatial_features)), drop = FALSE]
  pdf(paste0("Scatter_plots_", colnames(y), "_", paste0("Gobbini_spatial_", names(data_spatial)[i])))
  scatter_plots(x, y, "spearman")
  dev.off()

  #Correlation plot deconvolution vs groundtruth
  corr_matrix = compute.benchmark(deconv, spatial_features, corr_type = "spearman", plot = T, scatter = F, pval = 0.05, 
                                cells_extra = c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3", "Tcells", "uncharacterized_cell"), 
                                file_name = paste0("Gobbini_spatial_", names(data_spatial)[i]), height = 10, width = 8)
}
```

Correlation plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
#####Scatter plot function
scatter_plots = function(deconv, ground, method){
  for (i in 1:ncol(deconv)) {
    data = cbind(deconv[,i], ground)
    colnames(data) = c("x", "y")
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +  # Customize the points
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, color = "red") +  # Add regression line
      theme_minimal() +  # Apply a minimal theme
      labs(
        #title = paste0("Linear correlation - ", colnames(ground)),  # Set the title
        x = colnames(deconv)[i],                 # Set the x-axis label
        y = colnames(ground)                # Set the y-axis label
      ) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),  # Adjust title font size and position
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15)                # Adjust axis label font size
      ) +
      stat_cor(method = method,label.x = summary(data[,1])[[5]]-0.02, label.y = summary(data[,2])[[5]]+0.005)  # Add correlation coefficient
    
    print(p)
  }
}
```
